veranderings.blok: Die vaardigheid bly by die mens
veranderings.voor: bied hierdie vaardigheid vir ander mense aan
veranderings.na: bied hierdie vaardigheid aan ander mense
veranderings.rede: 'Iets vir iemand aanbied' follows English 'offer for'; Afrikaans offers something 'aan' someone, and the separable 'aan' then need not be repeated.

veranderings.blok: Die vaardigheid bly by die mens
veranderings.voor: die werk wat met die vaardigheid gedoen is
veranderings.na: die werk wat met die vaardigheid gedoen word
veranderings.rede: This is a general statement about what a service is, so the present passive 'gedoen word' fits better than the perfect 'gedoen is'.

veranderings.voor: om gesond te word en 'n onderwyser
veranderings.na: om gesond te word, en 'n onderwyser
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it; the protected wording stays intact.
AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences with their own subject and verb, so it takes a comma.

veranderings.blok: Dienste wat oor 'n grens verkoop word
veranderings.rede: The sentence draws the conclusion from the visitor example, and 'So' links it to the previous sentence so it does not read as an unconnected new claim.

veranderings.voor: , wat 'n mens deur leer of oefening kry.
veranderings.na: . 'n Mens kry dit deur te leer of te oefen.
veranderings.rede: The relative 'wat' can attach to 'iets' rather than to 'die vermoë'; a separate sentence with 'dit' makes the reference clear and matches the study block's wording.

vlae.blok: Dienste wat oor 'n grens verkoop word / toerisme
vlae.teks: Toerisme is wanneer mense vir 'n kort tyd reis na 'n plek buite hulle gewone lewe: nie waar hulle woon, werk of skool gaan nie.
vlae.rede: More natural Afrikaans word order would be 'vir 'n kort tyd na 'n plek ... reis', and 'is wanneer' is a weak definition form; not changed because the identical sentence stands in the study block and in the glossary, which must stay identical, so a single change cannot be applied to only one of them. A person or the writer should decide for both at once.
